name: UF-ega-goldbox-portrait
note: EGA RPG character portrait, 128x128 (Gold Box / Ultima era). Outlines ≤2, no angle snap — at this size they'd eat the face. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/ega-goldbox-portrait.  (sample: seed 1028)

form.subject: a (grizzled dwarf warrior:1.3), (braided beard:1.2), horned helmet, stern face
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)

sample_command: pixelmon 'a (grizzled dwarf warrior:1.3), (braided beard:1.2), horned helmet, stern face, ega_art, EGA 16-color pixel art, character portrait, role-playing game, 1980s DOS game' --server rtx --no-open --show-prompt --lora ega-art-v2.safetensors --lora-strength 0.8 --negative '(3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)' --out 128x128 --palette EGA --despeckle 1 --snap-pixels --snap-method unfake --pixel-size 1x1 --thin-lines 2 --seed 1028
